_comment: Curated seed of high-priority US data brokers. Opt-out URLs/emails change often; verify before relying on them. category: people-search | marketing | risk | recruitment. difficulty: 1 easy web/email, 2 requires account/verification, 3 requires ID upload/notary/phone. jurisdiction is the broker's governing regime (US | GDPR | UK-GDPR); for US brokers the specific state-law template is chosen from the user's own residency, not this field. search_url (optional): GET URL template for the broker's public people-search with {first} {last} {city} {state} placeholders; values in the path get spaces turned into dashes, query values are URL-encoded. Absent/empty search_url means the broker is unsearchable and treated as assumed-exposed. scan (optional): config for the Playwright auto-scan pipeline -- {search_url (same template syntax as search_url above), result_selector (CSS selector for one result card), fields: {name, age, locations, relatives} (CSS selectors scoped within a result card)}. verified:false means the selectors are unconfirmed against a live page -- treat like opt-out URLs, needs a real scan to confirm before trusting. scan (optional): per-broker scan config -- search_url (as above), verified (false until selectors/URL confirmed against a live rendered page), optional result_selector + fields{name,age,locations,relatives} CSS selectors (omit selectors to use extract.py's generic fallback), notes. network (optional): shared-owner/database group id (peopleconnect | whitepages | beenverified | tps-family | ancestry | spokeo | radaris); a found/not_found/assumed verdict manually set on one member propagates to every sibling in the group (one shared database, one verdict) -- see docs/exposure-scan-plan.md. scan.url_confirmed: date the search_url was verified against a live rendered page. scan.skip: true = do not auto-scan (wizard/JS-shell/bot-wall); keep for the manual link only.

scan.notes: Verified live 2026-07-09 against a real profile: 8 cards extracted, real person surfaced. Tailwind markup -- age nests inside the h2 (handled by extract._name_text), locations are /people/ anchors, relatives are /find/person/ anchors in the mt-2 block.
Live check 2026-07-09: connection refused (twice) from a residential IP -- site down or blocking. URL pattern previously confirmed via indexed pages. Re-test before enabling.

NOTE: page ships a Next.js JSON blob containing 'there are no matches' fallback copy -- extract() checks visible text only so it isn't a false not_found.
